key_information_units.information: Eleving Group achieved record-high revenue of EUR 250.0 million in 2025 (15.5% year-on-year increase), with EBITDA reaching EUR 101.9 million (13.5% increase) and net profit stable at EUR 29.2 million; the net portfolio grew 20.2% to EUR 446.3 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report '2025 at a glance'; Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss and Other Comprehensive Income

key_information_units.information: Revenue breakdown shows traditional vehicle financing decreased 6.0% to EUR 67.0 million, flexible vehicle financing increased 25.9% to EUR 60.3 million, device financing contributed EUR 7.9 million (launched in 2025), and consumer lending grew 18.0% to EUR 114.8 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Keynote from the CEO section detailing business line contributions

key_information_units.information: Strategic launch of installment loans in European markets (Latvia, Estonia, Romania, Armenia), generating EUR 14.7 million in loan issuances during 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report sections on Operations in European markets and Business outlook

key_information_units.information: Introduction of smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda, building a EUR 13.5 million loan portfolio by year-end with 260 thousand customers.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Environmental information section and Management Report on Operations in African markets

key_information_units.information: Expansion into Tanzania as the 17th market, initially focusing on motorcycle financing.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Supervisory Board statement and Management Report Outlook

key_information_units.information: Pilot implementation of AI voice agents at call centers, demonstrating capacity to handle up to 20,000 calls per day (equivalent to 100 operators).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Operational efficiency and Outlook

key_information_units.information: Completion of EUR 40 million bond tap in March 2025, adding to existing EUR 50 million bonds from 2023.
Refinancing of EUR 150 million bonds maturing in 2026 and issuance of new EUR 275 million bonds in October 2025, marking the largest bond issuance in the Group's history.
Distribution of EUR 19.65 million in dividends during 2025, representing a 10% cash yield based on IPO share price.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Capital management section; Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows

key_information_units.information: Impairment expense increased to EUR 54.2 million in 2025 due to derecognition of long-overdue balances deemed unrecoverable, offset by reversal of accumulated impairment allowances.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 7 and Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss

key_information_units.information: Regulatory challenge in Moldova alleging non-compliance with consumer credit legislation regarding daily fees and total loan costs for approximately 1,080 contracts; subsidiary is contesting through administrative and judicial proceedings.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Regulatory matter in Moldova section

key_information_units.information: Post-reporting period, the Group secured approximately EUR 12.3 million in additional funding from P2P platforms and increased local borrowings in Kenya by EUR 6.3 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report Events after balance sheet date section
